summary.description: What was red, what caused it and what you changed; it goes into the commit's message.

changed.description: Whether you changed anything in the tree. False where the cause is not in the code.

reason.description: Where nothing was changed: what the cause is and what would settle it. Empty otherwise.

testFilter.description: The filter that selects the tests that prove the repair, written in what each leg's test runner takes after its filter option, as your task lists them. Empty is no filter: every test of each leg runs.

built.description: What you built or changed, by file.

tested.description: What you ran and what it showed, and what you could not run.

claims.description: What you claim of your own work. The engine builds and tests it itself, so say what you saw, not what you expect.

newRows.description: The id of every registry row filed in this work that the registry did not have before it, said again in full in each report; empty where none was filed or the repository keeps no registry.

blocked.description: What the repair needs that you cannot do, each with what stands in the way and what would let it be done. Empty where you can do all of it. Where it is not empty, a person is asked before anything of the repair is tested or folded.

what.description: What of the repair you cannot do.

why.description: What stands in the way, as you found it: a setting you may not change, something missing, a decision nobody made.

needs.description: What would let it be done: a decision, an access, a change elsewhere, and from whom.
